Raheem Sterling Pleads Guilty to Dangerous Driving

Footballer Raheem Sterling has pleaded guilty to dangerous driving after crashing his Lamborghini. He also admitted to possessing nitrous oxide. Footage from his arrest showed balloons and laughing gas canisters in the vehicle. Sterling was seen inhaling from a balloon prior to the crash. He faces potential prison time.
